name: Charles Paladilhe
original_name: シャルル・パラディール
source:
A famous stage actor.

He is also famous as a man who loves romance—so much so that it is rumored
every word he speaks to a woman is a pickup line.

As the rumors suggested, he's quite adept at handling women, and sometimes even toys with the protagonist with his nonchalant remarks.
